metadata.title: MAPP 6025.9 Good Review Practices: Standard Safety Tables and Figures
metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.
metadata.applicability: OND clinical review staff for NDAs, BLAs (PHS Act 351(a)) and efficacy supplements. States that applicants are not required to follow the ST&F formats and methods.

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: These displays are example analyses and should be modified and customized based on the specific study design(s), safety issues, and new issues that arise during the safety evaluation.
candidates.context: POLICY • ST&Fs serve as a framework for the display of clinical safety data in FDA reviews. • ST&Fs are typically generated for the following: ‒ Pivotal or registration trials ‒ Any other individual trial of interest to the OND clinical reviewer including those that differ substantially from the pivotal trial in key design characteristics (e.g., lead-in period, enrichment, population, duration, cross-over design) ‒ Pooled analyses (if appropriate)
